text:
maria: Heads up — after the auto-kernel-v2 rollout we're seeing a 5–12% tail latency regression on long prompts (>2k tokens). Posting quick traces and a flamegraph snapshot.

kevin: Oof. Is this on prod-sim or staging? /cc @jon we tweaked admit-window last week.

maria: This is from prod-sim run earlier today. Flame snippet: ```
p99: baseline 120ms -> now 128ms (+6.7%)
p95: 64ms -> 68ms
avg cpu% up ~3% on decoder
kvcache hit-rate dropped from 0.72 -> 0.48 for the 3k token test
batch-size histogram shifted right (median +18%)
```

jon: Two quick thoughts:
- The kernel change reduces per-token compute for short contexts but it seems to interact poorly with KV-cache misses so batching grows.
- Continuous-batching heuristic is probably allowing large batches because admit-window + token-budget don't account for effective kvcache miss inflation.

jon: Proposal: introduce a "token-lease" cap and a dynamic admit-window shrink when kv-hit < THRESHOLD. Pseudocode: ```
if kv_hit_rate < 0.6:
  max_tokens_per_batch = min(global_max, 2048)
  admit_window_ms = max(20, base_window_ms * 0.5)
else:
  admit_window_ms = base_window_ms
```
Also use soft-429: return 429 with Retry-After when queue_length_tokens > token_budget * 1.5, otherwise soft-shed (partial accept) by trimming prefix caching TTL.

sophia: I can run an experiment on staging. config I used earlier for a similar tuning: ```json
{"experiment": "admit-window-token-lease-v1", "stages": ["canary-5%","canary-25%","full"], "metrics": ["p50","p95","p99","kv_hit","avg_batch_tokens","reject_rate"]}```

kevin: Prefer soft-shed for latency-sensitive tenants (+1). Hard 429s ok for best-effort routes. We should label tenants in routing table and only apply hard rejects to non-critical.

david: Quick note on kernels: A100 fused-attn helped throughput but increased memory pressure on long contexts -> more GC stalls and worse queue jitter. Might need to select kernel based on expected kv-hit and seq-len distribution, not globally.

ci-bot: perf-regression-alert: job #4523 detected 7.8% p99 increase on prod-sim. Details: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/4523 (automated snapshot attached).

maria: I'll push a small admit-window + token-lease patch to staging and start admit-window-token-lease-v1 canary at 5% tomorrow. Will log batch-size histograms and kv-hit per model.

jon: Add synthetic 3k-token trace A/B with kv-hit=0.3 for the experiment and capture kernel-selection tag per request. Also include per-batch latency vs batch-size scatter.

kevin: Sounds good. Please post results in #eng-runtime when canary completes. :thumbsup:
